description: Shows one interactive 3D model from world.lapla.si in the conversation, opening at the chapter that answers the user’s question; the user can turn it, step through its chapters and try its lab. Use it after search_models with the slug and chapter (and params) it returned, or when the user names a plate. Also returns a short text summary and the plate’s link, for clients that show no UI.

chapter.description: The chapter id to open at, from search_models or list_chapters (e.g. "tilt"). Default: the cover.

params.description: Lab settings by id, from search_models or list_chapters: a number for a slider, an option id for a choice, true/false for a toggle.

name: show_model
title: Show a live 3D model
